newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' July jobless rate down to 7.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' July jobless rate down to 7.7 percent.

text.p: The Philippines' unemployment rate was down to 7.7 percent in July from the year-ago month figure of 8.8 percent, according to preliminary results reported by the National Statistics Office (NSO) on Thursday.
Among the regions in the country, Metro Manila recorded the highest unemployment rate of 11.5 percent, the survey showed.

In terms of sectors, the agricultural segment had 40.5 percent of the total workforce in the country. The industry sector had a share of 17.6 percent and services accounted for the remaining 41.9 percent.
The NSO conducts surveys on labour force statistics every three months.
